role: Assistant Secretary for Health and Scientific Affairs, Department of Health, Education, and Welfare
stance_basis: statement says proposed highway construction does not appear to represent a hazard to public health and safety
summary: Merlin K. DuVal, M.D., as representative of the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare, reviewed the health aspects of the proposed Lincoln Highway project and found no hazard to public health and safety. His comment was brief and non-objecting, resulting in a concurrence from the project preparers.
complaint_summary: The Department of Health, Education, and Welfare reviewed the health aspects of the project and found that the proposed highway construction does not appear to represent a hazard to public health and safety.

statement.text: This Department has reviewed the health aspects of the above project as presenting the documents submitted. The proposed highway construction does not appear to represent a hazard to public health and safety.
